title: Bound Docker watcher schedule count
invariant: For a single filtered root in Docker polling mode, choose the polling observer and schedule one recursive root watch regardless of the number of eligible top-level children.
scope: Historical constructor, start and polling entry snippets; one existing root, exclusion filter enabled, eligible top-level children. Lean is generated from checked AST branches and abstracts observer scheduling only. It does not prove Python-to-Lean equivalence, OS thread counts, Docker behavior, performance, or event delivery. replay.py exercises the historical Python slices against recording observers.
